description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Zealous Lorecaster
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Zealous Lorecaster
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
